name: coder-agents
description: A concise shared setup for AI coding assistants, agnostic of programming languages, agent frameworks, and host tools. Ships one governance manifesto (AGENTS.md) whose spine is the AI-native delivery lifecycle, seventeen on-demand skills (artifacts, confluence, craft, domain-modeling, evals, modernize-coding, graph-engineering, grilling, indexed-search, lifecycle, performance, security-audit, solution-architecture, system-diagramming, teamwork, verification, wayfinder), four routine-task command workflows, and deterministic verification gates.
